===Pronunciation===

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|education}} A [[document]], on [[cardboard]] or [[plain paper]], [[indicate|indicating]] the [[grade]]s that a [[student]] has earned, [[issue]]d at the end of a [[term]] of a [[regular]] [[period]].
# {{lb|en|informal|by extension}} An update on progress with regard to a policy or system.
